page_title: REN 1-2 LOR | Rennes v Lorient 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' Martin Terrier (Rennes) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
90+6' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+6' Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

90+3' 1 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Benjamin Bourigeaud, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Amine Gouiri (Rennes), who beats Yvon Mvogo with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 0 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) was set free in the area by Gedeon Kalulu and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the right side of the net. 0:2.

88' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
88' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
87' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
82' Julien Stephan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) replacing Arnaud Kalimuendo.
82' Here comes a substitution. Warmed Omari is given a rest as he is replaced by Christopher Wooh (Rennes).
82' It's time for a substitution. Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) comes on in place of Desire Doue.
82' Problems for Regis Le Bris as Mohamed Bamba is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) replaces him.
82' Regis Le Bris decides to make a substitution. Ayman Kari will be replaced by Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient).
82' Substitution. Panos Katseris makes his way off the pitch and Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) comes on as his replacement.
80' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the corner but it's cleared.
78' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
75' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lorient was in an offside position.
74' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alidu Seidu leaves the pitch and Guela Doue (Rennes) comes on.
72' Today's referee Benoit Bastien rightly decides to book Laurent Abergel (Lorient) for his harsh tackle.

72' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Yvon Mvogo allowed him to make a comfortable save.
71' Panos Katseris (Lorient) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
69' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
67' Julien Stephan prepares a substitution. Baptiste Santamaria is replaced by Amine Gouiri (Rennes).

66' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Steve Mandanda!
65' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
64' A pass by Panos Katseris (Lorient) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
63' Rennes take a short corner kick.
63' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Desire Doue (Rennes). The referee signals a corner kick to Rennes.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lorient comes to nothing.
62' Panos Katseris (Lorient) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' 0 - 1 Goal! Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.
59' A snap shot by Julien Ponceau (Lorient) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Steve Mandanda produces a good save to thwart him.

58' What a big chance! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and misses the net well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
57' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
56' Isaak Toure (Lorient) sees a yellow card from Benoit Bastien after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
56' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
55' Desire Doue (Rennes) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Yvon Mvogo makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
52' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
51' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Rennes have a corner.

50' What a chance that is! Desire Doue (Rennes) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
49' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
48' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Desire Doue (Rennes) but poses no threat.
46' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Adrien Truffert (Rennes). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Benoit Bastien has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
43' Nathaniel Adjei (Lorient) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

40' The fans were almost celebrating as Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball was heading towards the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo made an astonishing save!
38' Desire Doue (Rennes) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Yvon Mvogo stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
37' Isaak Toure (Lorient) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
35' The resulting corner from Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is cleared by the defence.
35' Surely that's handball by one of the Lorient players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
34' Panos Katseris (Lorient) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
34' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
33' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
32' Ayman Kari (Lorient) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Steve Mandanda intercepts the ball.
30' A pass from Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is intercepted by Yvon Mvogo and the move breaks down.

29' Nathaniel Adjei (Lorient) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
29' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
29' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ayman Kari (Lorient). Lorient have a corner.

27' A precise low pass is received by Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
27' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
25' Lorient enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
22' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Julien Ponceau (Lorient), but the defence gets it clear.
19' Martin Terrier (Rennes) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
17' A dangerous looking corner kick from Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is cleared to safety by the defence.
15' An attempted cross from Desire Doue (Rennes) is cleared.
14' Panos Katseris (Lorient) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
12' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
9' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) was too forceful with his tackle and Benoit Bastien interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
6' What a great touch by Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the centre of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
5' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes.
3' Ayman Kari (Lorient) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
1' The first half has just begun.
Rennes will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Benoit Bastien.
